source_dates_provenance_storage: shared and retained for every representation, not included in numeric-vector bytes
native_direct_fallback_cost: actual whole-test-fires measurement in access-independent-validation.json; not substituted with encoding latency
unknown_components: index/recipe rights or independent ecological validity
fitted_model_costs: observed actual fitting and probe stages; probe-fit-and-predict timing includes full-population inference, so not pure training CPU
retrieval_index_costs: separately measured in retrieval-runtime.json; not silently charged to property-query workload
